output:
**Subject:** Order TH-48217 – marked delivered but never arrived: resend or refund by Fri 13 Nov

Dear Tiny Hands team,

I'm writing about order TH-48217, and I'll be honest, I'm at the end of my rope with this one. This is my third contact about it and I've had basically the same non-answer each time, so I'd like this to land with someone who can actually do something about it.

**The order:** placed 21 October, R1,640 paid by card, including R95 delivery. Items were 6 tubs of finger paint, 4 bags of playdough, 200 paper plates, googly eyes, glitter glue and 2 rolls of brown paper. Delivery address was correct — Bergview Pre-Primary, Plumstead.

**What happened:** courier tracking says it was delivered on Tuesday 3 November at 11:42, signed for by "M. Adams". There is no M. Adams at our school. Our gate guard, Uncle Faizel, keeps a log of every delivery that comes through the gate and nothing is recorded for the 3rd. I've also asked around the school and nobody has received anything. So either it was signed for by someone with no connection to our school, or it went somewhere else entirely. Either way, I don't have the supplies and I've paid R1,640 for them.

**What I've had so far:** I emailed on 4 November and again on 6 November and received the same copy-and-paste reply both times saying my query had been "escalated to our courier partner". I phoned on Friday, waited 38 minutes on hold, and was told the lady on the line couldn't do anything until the courier finished their investigation, which could take 10 working days. I'm not trying to be difficult, but that just means the query goes nowhere and I'm left standing still.

**Why this matters to me:** my contract is with Tiny Hands, not with the courier, and I never chose or appointed them. I'd rather not be chasing a company you put in place — please deal with them and come back to me with an outcome. These are supplies for my class, bought with my own money, and R1,640 is a real chunk of a teacher's salary. I've ordered from you three times before with no issues at all, which is honestly what makes this so maddening.

The children made their mask patterns for our end of year concert last week and I've been telling them the paint is "coming soon" for a week now. The concert is on 27 November and I need these materials for the props. Every day this drags on, I'm the one standing in front of five-year-olds making excuses.

**What I'm asking for:** either a resend of the full order, or a full refund of R1,640 including the R95 delivery fee, by Friday 13 November. If it's a refund rather than a resend, I'd like the delivery fee included, since the delivery didn't happen.

I'd also really like a reply from an actual person who can tell me what's happening and by when — not another template. If I don't get a clear answer by Friday 13 November, I will have to dispute the payment with my bank as a chargeback, and I'll be leaving an honest review as well. I'd genuinely prefer not to do that. I'd rather just get my supplies or my money back and get on with my week.

Please treat this as urgent and get back to me in writing.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
Kindergarten Teacher
Bergview Pre-Primary, Plumstead
[Phone number]
